mode_evidence: Sparks, flashes, streaks of quick and lingering light, and 'phosphor clouds' are said to be seen 'before the face' in a dark room, and clouds are seen moving on the mirror's face; a correspondent reports a pale golden misty light cut by flashes seen with a bandaged, shut eye. Randolph also says true vision occurs in 'interior repose' when outward light is separated, and that sparks may resolve into forms, so his seen light shades into imaginal seeing.
onset_evidence: If after a few minutes in a quite dark room sparks, flashes, streaks or phosphor clouds appear, the person can become clairvoyant by continuance and repetition. To someone who sees nothing: a steady-gaze test (a speck on the wall six minutes), rapid forcible breathing for ninety seconds, a horse-shoe magnet operation lying down, mirror-gazing, and patience. Persons already seeing fiery sparks that glitter and vanish into blank void are called splendid seers. Not forced: 'Mystery never opens her dark doors to the impatient seeker'; he admits some try long without success.

conditions.posture: lying down for the magnet and breath operation
conditions.gaze_or_eye_position: steady look at a speck on the wall for six minutes; mirror gazing; a bandage with thicknesses of paper over eyes and forehead at night in one correspondent's practice
conditions.setting: quite dark room (said to be twenty times more productive than a lit one); moonlight next best, starlight better still
conditions.duration_and_schedule: a few minutes for sparks to show; sittings repeated; one correspondent waited twenty minutes before the first appearance and three weeks before the eye-form
conditions.prerequisites: health, cleanliness, freedom from doubt, irritability and impatience; steady will, lung power
conditions.other: magnetic mirrors of black polished glass used afterward

stages.label: sparks and phosphor clouds
stages.description: Sparks, flashes and streaks of quick and lingering light, or phosphor clouds floating before the face.

stages.label: clouds on the mirror
stages.description: The first sign in mirror work: curious clouds moving on the glass, then phantoramas.

stages.label: forms
stages.description: The clouds and sparks may resolve into forms of departed friends; a correspondent saw a golden misty light, a moving spot that became an eye with blue pupil and gold ring.

what_to_do_with_light: Continue and repeat the sitting; watch the sparks and clouds until they resolve into forms; keep patience and moral steadiness.
obstacles_and_fixes: Nothing appears: continue; some are not susceptible
Impatience, doubt, irritability, ill health defeat the power
Artificial or solar light lowers results
cautions: Under lust, hatred, avarice or wrong no man can enter
Spiritual trance mediumship is mostly delusion; true seership is experience, not hearsay
Rapid forcible breathing for ninety seconds is described as making the subject dizzy, repeated it is almost certain to produce coma
interpretation: Sparks and flashes are 'instantaneous penetrations' of the veil between the outer world of dark and cold and the inner realm of light and fire; true clairvoyance is the lengthened uplifting of that veil.
practice_summary: Sit or lie in a quite dark room, ideally with moonlight or starlight as the next best condition. Look steadily at a speck on the wall for six minutes, or breathe rapidly and forcibly for ninety seconds, then lie still. After a few minutes watch for sparks, flashes, streaks or phosphor clouds before the face. If they come, he says continuance and repetition will make you clairvoyant, and the clouds may resolve into forms. Mirror gazing in a dark chamber is the second method; the first sign there is clouds passing over the glass. One correspondent wore a paper-padded bandage over the eyes at night and after weeks saw a golden misty light and a moving eye-shaped spot. Stay patient, clean and calm; impatience closes the door.
